text:
Property prices never fall? The official indexes say otherwise.

US: the S&P Case-Shiller 10-City index fell 34% from April 2006 to January 2012. China: new home prices down 2.4% year on year in October 2026 (NBS via Reuters). India: the RBI House Price Index rose 3.6% in April to June 2026, while CPI inflation was 4.38% in June (MoSPI).

Rising is not the same as growing. Check the index, not the brochure. Educational content, not advice.
